text_block_list.text:
It all started when I got in touch with<n>Ines Fujin's
mother after the Kikuka<n>Sho.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
My twins are both saying that they<n>want to attend
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I need to visit the hospital, and I've<n>asked my
husband to accompany me.<n>It really shames me
that we can't be<n>there for our daughters...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I want the three of them to get<n>together again and
talk. Could I ask<n>you to help out, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for involving you in our<n>family affairs...
choice_data_list: It's fine. I'm happy to be of help.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. Please take good<n>care of my
daughters.

Judging from Ines Fujin's behavior<n>and the way
her conversations with<n>her sisters have gone up
until now...

It seems they're not quite<n>understanding each
other properly.<n>Having me there as a third party
might help them untangle the mess<n>they've found
themselves in.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The train my sisters are on should be<n>arriving
shortly.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: Hey, Big Sis! Hey, Trainer! Let's have<n>fun today!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Polly, Cassie...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
choice_data_list: I'm sure we'll have a blast.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, thank you for accompanying<n>us.

Despite the awkward vibe that hangs<n>in the air, we
set out for Nakayama<n>Racecourse, where the Arima
Kinen<n>takes place.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's way more like a festival<n>this time!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Of course—this is the Arima Kinen!<n>Let's hold hands
tightly so nobody<n>gets separated.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: We're fine. You don't need to treat<n>us like babies!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: Don't be like that, Cassie!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: No! I don't want to listen to Big Sis<n>anymore! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Cassie. I caused you two a<n>lot of trouble
because I was being<n>selfish.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's okay now, though, because I'll<n>help get your
dreams back. You can<n>rest easy knowing you'll be
able to<n>restart your dance classes!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: That's not what I want! You're a big<n>dummy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Cassie! Where are you going?<n>What are you
so angry about?!
choice_data_list: Maybe because you jumped to conclusions...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Let's find her and hear how she really feels!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Uh, right!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
P-please let me through! Erm, I want<n>to get to the
front!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That was Cassie's voice!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there, little one. Are you here<n>to watch
Oguri's race too? You look<n>super amped.

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text:
Aww, and she looks just like Ines!<n>What a cutie!
Hey, where's your<n>mommy? Are you lost?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: S-sorry about this! That's my little<n>sister!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Huh?! For real?! You're Ines's little<n>sister?!

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's crazy that you sisters all<n>love racing! Is
your dream to grow up<n>to be like your big sis?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No, no. She's got a real talent for<n>dancing, so her
dream is to be—

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: You're wrong!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: ...That's not it at all! My... my dream<n>is...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
To cheer as loud as I can for my big<n>sis as she
finishes in first place!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I get ya! Just watching Ines run<n>really perks
me right up, too.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? I love watching her run<n>so much that
it kinda turned my world<n>upside down.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
I never knew anything about racing<n>before. I used
to just work, eat, and<n>sleep. That was pretty much
my<n>whole day!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
I didn't have a goal or anything like<n>that—just my
part-time gig. My life<n>was totally boring.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
But then I saw your big sis working<n>her butt off at
that boring job. She<n>had like this glowing aura!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: So I got a little interested and went towatch a race, just out of curiosity.And Ines was crazy fast!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
She was, like, super-hyped right up<n>until she
collapsed. After seeing that<n>for the first time...

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
It made me feel like I should really go<n>all out for
some kind of purpose. Ya<n>know? Giving it
everything until I<n>can't stand anymore.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way! Seeing Big Sis<n>run gives me
courage!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: That's why... I really, really love her<n>running!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Cassie, I...
choice_data_list: Will you two tell us your dreams?

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Me and Cassie just want to cheer<n>for our big sis
when she races. Right?

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Right... That's why we decided.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
We're going to take care of Mom and<n>the house,
just like Big Sis did for us<n>before!

As expected of a race featuring Oguri<n>Cap, the
Arima Kinen was an<n>engrossing event. But on the
way<n>home, Ines Fujin appears to be lost<n>in thought.
choice_data_list: What did you think of the race today?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, um...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Oguri was amazing! But I wanna<n>watch Big Sis race
next time!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks, Polly.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
I want you to keep competing in<n>heaps of races!
Seeing you run hard,<n>smile, and take home first
place...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: That's the dream our whole family<n>shares!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But, Cassie...
choice_data_list: Their dream is for you to run, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Their dream...
choice_data_list: And I feel the exact same way.
And I feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I always thought my racing career<n>was just a
selfish desire.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Listen, Cassie, Polly. Can I ask a<n>favor of you both?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you two could do your<n>best to help out
around the house?<n>That way, I'd be able to enter
more<n>races.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Can I depend on you?

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If it means you'll get to<n>compete more, we'll
do it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It will. I'll be able to run my heart out,<n>and enjoy
any race I enter.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thank you both... truly.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Hehe, no problem!
choice_data_list: It's time to run for everyone's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You got it, Trainer!

Ines Fujin and her sisters are<n>illuminated by the
sunset over<n>Nakayama Racecourse, where<n>dreams
cross paths.
